final.summary: One similar prior decision: reviewers judged comparable code not exploitable, for a reason specific to that code. This issue itself has not been decided.

precedents.title: Image proxy fetches any URL from the query string in the admin variant
precedents.rationale: Reviewers found the input constrained before it is used.
precedents.quote: Not exploitable: the proxy runs in a network namespace with egress limited to the public CDN.
